list.name: datasource
list.label: Data Source
list.description: The MySQL data source for the Spectrum reporting database. Set this to your own after importing.

list.name: group
list.label: Global Collection
list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name
list.definition: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: deviceType
list.label: Device Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100*(1 - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))),0) FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())) / ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.model_key) FROM reporting.devicemodel dm WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices))) * TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()))) AS fleet_availability_pct

SELECT COUNT(*) AS outages FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mo.model_key) AS devices_affected FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())

SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo()))))/3600,1) AS downtime_hrs FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())

SELECT $__timeGroup(mo.start_time,'1d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS outages FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND $__timeFilter(mo.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.entity_name AS Device, ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo()))))/60) AS `Downtime` FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom()) GROUP BY e.entity_name HAVING SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) > 0 ORDER BY `Downtime` DESC LIMIT $topN

SELECT e.entity_name AS `Name`, dm.IP AS `IP`, dm.device_type AS `Device Type`, CONCAT(FLOOR(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo()))))/86400),' Days ',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))),86400)/3600),2,'0'),':',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))),3600)/60),2,'0'),':',LPAD(MOD(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))),60),2,'0')) AS `Total Downtime`, COUNT(*) AS `Number of Outages`, ROUND(100*(1 - SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo()))))/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo())),4) AS `Availability %` FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom()) GROUP BY e.entity_name, dm.IP, dm.device_type ORDER BY SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) DESC LIMIT $topN
